name: Rowan Kenrith
description: A knight-trained planeswalker who uses electrical magic and shares a Spark with her brother Will.

timeline.summary: Rowan opens a portal and steps through, and Will is pulled after her.
timeline.quote: Rowan grinned and waved as she stepped into the light and disappeared.

timeline.summary: The twins arrive on Arcavios where Kasmina and her owl greet them.
timeline.quote: I see you've both made it.

timeline.summary: They pass a huge silver torch on the road to the school.
timeline.quote: The silver column rose high above the trees, piercing the brilliant blue sky.

timeline.summary: Kasmina welcomes them to Strixhaven as they crest a ridge over the campus.
timeline.quote: Welcome to Strixhaven.

timeline.summary: Kasmina leaves them at the gates, telling them to find Mavinda Sharpbeak.
timeline.quote: Look for an owlin called Mavinda Sharpbeak.

timeline.summary: The twins find Prismari and Silverquill students dueling in a courtyard.
timeline.quote: two groups of students flung spells across a grassy field

timeline.summary: Rowan zaps a Silverquill student preparing an ink spell to protect a Prismari student.
timeline.quote: She sent a jolt of electricity at the one preparing the ink spell.

timeline.summary: A coil of living ink sweeps Rowan's feet from under her.
timeline.quote: a coil of living ink swept her feet out from under her

timeline.summary: Will's ruined Memoirs of Thadus pushes him to join the fight alongside Rowan.
timeline.quote: Maybe it is our fight.

timeline.summary: Will and Rowan combine ice and lightning, but the spells fail to blend smoothly.
timeline.quote: Something wasn't right.

timeline.summary: Liliana notices the twins mention Kylem and wonders if they are planeswalkers who could be useful.
timeline.quote: They probably weren't Oriq agents.

timeline.summary: In their dorm, Will says their combined magic failed and wonders whether the plane affects it.
timeline.quote: it should have been smoother. More cohesive.

timeline.summary: Rowan leaves to live her own life, and Will resolves to find answers alone.
timeline.quote: We may be twins, but I'm allowed to live my own life.

timeline.summary: Liliana sees Rowan Kenrith with friends and decides to take her professor role more seriously.
timeline.quote: Maybe it's time to take my role as a Professor a little more seriously.

timeline.summary: Will and Rowan argue about her lack of study, and lightning sparks from her hair when she gets angry.
timeline.quote: it was the coils of electricity jumping between loose strands of hair on his sister's face

timeline.summary: Will confronts Rowan at Bow's End about barely passing Professor Onyx's exam.
timeline.quote: You barely passed, Rowan

timeline.summary: Will invokes their birth mother, and Rowan's anger crackles through the air.
timeline.quote: Will could feel the hair on his arms stand up as an electric charge coursed through the air around him.

timeline.summary: Rowan leaves with her Witherbloom friends, telling Will to leave her alone.
timeline.quote: Leave me alone, Will. You can't tell me what to do.

timeline.summary: The twins stop speaking for weeks until the Mage Tower match.
timeline.quote: he hadn't spoken to her in weeks

timeline.summary: Will provokes Rowan in the stands, and she shocks him with lightning.
timeline.quote: Will felt the spark jump from her outstretched hand and pass through his whole body in an instant.

timeline.summary: Will freezes Rowan's boots and hand with his ice magic.
timeline.quote: Rowan gasped as a rime of frost suddenly solidified around her boots, freezing her feet in place.

timeline.summary: Professor Onyx stops the fight and takes the twins to her office.
timeline.quote: He squinted as he looked up, meeting Professor Onyx's gaze.

timeline.summary: Professor Onyx warns the twins about the Oriq and hints Strixhaven does not hold all power on the plane, leaving Will suspecting she is a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Strixhaven doesn't have a monopoly on power in this plane.

timeline.summary: Will wants to prepare to defend the students, while Rowan says she will prepare her own way.
timeline.quote: I'll prepare my own way for whatever's coming.

timeline.summary: Kasmina watches Rowan practice lightning through her owl.
timeline.quote: Below, she could see the Kenrith girl sending forked lightning across the lawn.

timeline.summary: Auvernine siphons the life force of a saltgobbler into a potion.
timeline.quote: Rowan's hand went to her mouth as she watched the creature's life force flow through the air and into her friend's potion.

timeline.summary: Rowan siphons power from a water elemental in the Biblioplex.
timeline.quote: Electricity crackled and leapt across her fingers as she pulled the veins of power out of its watery surface, toward her.

timeline.summary: Rowan tells Will she has learned that breaking the rules gets things done and leaves him.
timeline.quote: I learned that when you're not afraid to break the rules, you can get a whole lot done.

timeline.summary: Rowan, Plink and Auvernine fight mage hunters at the Witherbloom dormitories.
timeline.quote: Rowan howled and swung her sword.

timeline.summary: Rowan decides to head for the Biblioplex, where she expects Will to be.
timeline.quote: If she knew her brother, that's where he would be.

timeline.summary: Will and Rowan reunite and hug.
timeline.quote: They ran toward each other and fell into a hug, squeezing each other tightly.

timeline.summary: Professor Onyx kills an Oriq agent aiming at the twins.
timeline.quote: When she opened them, she saw the Oriq splayed across the ground.

timeline.summary: Onyx tells them the mage hunters have formed a perimeter around the Biblioplex.
timeline.quote: They've formed a perimeter around the Biblioplex.

timeline.summary: Onyx admits she is not a responsible professor and recruits the twins to help her.
timeline.quote: No. I'm not quite so responsible as that. And I need help.

timeline.summary: Onyx opens an old maintenance passage she found as a student.
timeline.quote: It's an old maintenance passage I found when I was a student.

timeline.summary: Will saves Rowan from falling through a rotting bridge.
timeline.quote: Will dove as Rowan fell, locking one hand around her wrist.

timeline.summary: Onyx reveals she is leading them to where the most damage could be done.
timeline.quote: I'm taking you where I would go, if I wanted to cause the most damage possible.

timeline.summary: The twins zap and ice-bind Oriq agents as Liliana leads them to the Snarl.
timeline.quote: at the first sign of one of the masked Oriq, Rowan would zap them with a current of energy that left them twitching on the ground

timeline.summary: Rowan blasts a group of Oriq with lightning, and Liliana pushes the soul out of an agent threatening her.
timeline.quote: With a savage thrust of will, she pushed it free of his body, which dropped in a heap on the floor.

timeline.summary: Extus freezes and shatters Rowan's lightning and breaks Will's ice shield.
timeline.quote: shattering on the ground as if made of glass

timeline.summary: Rowan proposes to draw power from the Snarl, but Will says it is too dangerous.
timeline.quote: That's too dangerous!

timeline.summary: The four-armed Blood Avatar rises from the blood fountain in a bronze helmet.
timeline.quote: In each of its four muscular arms, it clutched a cruel weapon

timeline.summary: Rowan realizes the avatar was Extus's plan all along.
timeline.quote: This was Extus's plan all along.

timeline.summary: Will's ice shards at Extus are blown apart by Rowan's lightning.
timeline.quote: a bolt of lightning cracked through the shards, detonating them

timeline.summary: Rubble knocks Will down, and Rowan fails to hurt the Blood Avatar's sword.
timeline.quote: The monster only pulled its sword free, throwing her backward.

timeline.summary: Rowan reaches out and draws on the power of the Snarl.
timeline.quote: Rowan took a deep breath, closed her eyes, and reached out.

timeline.summary: Extus sees the Blood Avatar faltering as the Snarl's energy flows into Rowan.
timeline.quote: The creature was moving in jerks and fits, the red light of the Snarl flickering wildly behind it.

timeline.summary: Rowan blasts Extus with fire that hurls him against the wall.
timeline.quote: the spell crashed into him, sending him flying through the air, robes coiling with smoke

timeline.summary: The Snarl's power backfires and Rowan collapses, drained.
timeline.quote: All the strength abruptly left her limbs and she flopped limply out of the air

timeline.summary: Extus dismisses Rowan's ambition and returns to his ritual.
timeline.quote: But I've come too far to be stopped by the likes of you.

timeline.summary: The twins apologize to each other for their fights.
timeline.quote: I'm sorry about the fight.

timeline.summary: Will realizes the Blood Avatar can be controlled like the Mage Tower mascot.
timeline.quote: It's like a mascot!

timeline.summary: Rowan pours her last magical energy into Will, completing the spell.
timeline.quote: Rowan poured the last of her magical energy into her brother

timeline.summary: The spell breaks and the Blood Avatar's sword takes Will's lower right leg as it is pulled back into the Snarl.
timeline.quote: below the knee, his right leg was gone

timeline.summary: As the hall collapses, Deans Nassari and Lisette rescue the twins.
timeline.quote: Brows furrowed in concentration, they sent gouts of magic through the air, blasting away falling rocks and debris.

timeline.summary: Nassari assures Rowan that Will will live.
timeline.quote: He'll live,

timeline.summary: Will insists they should stay and study because they beat the Avatar with a spell learned at Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: We took down a Blood Avatar with a spell that we learned here

timeline.summary: Rowan, noticeably thinner, tells Will she loves him.
timeline.quote: You know I love you, right?

timeline.summary: Will and Rowan meet the rebel knight Imodane, who calls herself queen and mocks Will as pathetic.
timeline.quote: "The only reason I agreed to this little meeting was to see if you were as pathetic as I'd heard."

timeline.summary: As Imodane raises her hammer over Will, Rowan unleashes a huge lightning bolt that splits the mountainside.
timeline.quote: Rowan's cut a massive rift into the side of the nearest peak.

timeline.summary: Terrified, Imodane drops her hammer and flees into the woods, while Will stares at Rowan in fear.
timeline.quote: Imodane drops the hammer, turns tail, and runs.

timeline.summary: Rowan tells Will she is leaving to find a magical cure for the Wicked Slumber; they argue about his unearned title and her outburst.
timeline.quote: You just decided to call yourself High King because you thought it suited you

timeline.summary: Rowan tries to planeswalk but cannot feel her spark, and says she is leaving anyway.
timeline.quote: She can't clear her mind enough to planeswalk.

timeline.summary: Rowan stays with Royse the weaver, who reveals her true eight-eyed form and directs her to an ancient castle.
timeline.quote: revealing eight eyes, two chittering mandibles, eight arms hidden beneath her stole.

timeline.summary: Rowan finds the castle's library empty and collapses in rage and tears.
timeline.quote: Alone in the abandoned castle, Rowan Kenrith becomes a storm.

timeline.summary: Rowan dreams of a feast where her parents give her their crown and tell her to come to Castle Ardenvale; she wakes resolved to go.
timeline.quote: "Come to Castle Ardenvale. Your blood awaits you there."

timeline.summary: Rowan receives a letter from Will asking her to come home but refuses to return, sending him a blank page.
timeline.quote: "Give him this, and tell him to come find me if he's serious."

timeline.summary: Rowan blasts through Castle Ardenvale's gates and fights her way up the stairs through slumbering knights who attack her, including Saxon and Joshua.
timeline.quote: Aiming at his feet and Saxon's, she channels another blast.

timeline.summary: Rowan is swept into a waltz of slumbering knights and met by Ashiok in the Court of the Ardent Queen.
timeline.quote: "Welcome to the Court of the Ardent Queen, Rowan Kenrith."

timeline.summary: Ashiok leads Rowan to Eriette, who says she brought her there because she admires Rowan's fire.
timeline.quote: "Dear Rowan, I brought you here because I admire the fire within you."

timeline.summary: Eriette explains she created the Wicked Slumber to protect her people from the invaders, and Ashiok conjures an illusion of Rowan's parents.
timeline.quote: When she opens her eyes again her parents are standing at the woman's side.

timeline.summary: Eriette is revealed to be Rowan's aunt, sister of the mother who tried to drink Rowan's blood, and tells her she can redeem their line.
timeline.quote: "Your mother was the cruelest of us.

timeline.summary: Eriette offers Rowan power and tells her the Slumber grants dreamers their wishes while their bodies serve her will.
timeline.quote: "I want power ," says the woman.

timeline.summary: Ashiok says Rowan's spark is gone, and Eriette welcomes Rowan as her heir; Rowan accepts her embrace.
timeline.quote: "My name is Eriette, darling. Welcome home."

timeline.summary: Inside they find Rowan in the throne room studying curse notes; Kellan reads her note about attempting to put people to sleep before she knocks him out with sparks.
timeline.quote: Kellan's vision goes white.

timeline.summary: Kellan wakes in a cell, freed by Ruby, who says Rowan knocked them out and was trying to work dream magic on him when Will's army arrived.
timeline.quote: "Syr Rowan knocked us both out.

timeline.summary: Will's knights burst into Ardenvale as Eriette strains to control sleepers and Rowan blasts the floor before Imodane.
timeline.quote: All of this energy she unleashes in a fearsome bolt aimed at Imodane's feet.

timeline.summary: Rowan and Will confront each other; he pleads for her to come home but she attacks him with her sword.
timeline.quote: "Home is gone, Will!"

timeline.summary: Kellan and Ruby attack Eriette's throne while Rowan reveals Eriette is their aunt and begs Will to save her; Will says he doesn't know her anymore.
timeline.quote: "I don't know you anymore," he says.

timeline.summary: Ashiok returns and takes control of the sleepers, turning the battle against Will's knights.
timeline.quote: Veils of black coalesce into Ashiok's elegant form before the gathered army.

timeline.summary: Ruby holds her blade to Eriette's throat; Eriette tells Rowan by thread to leave and bide their time.
timeline.quote: Go from this place, Eriette says to her. When the time is right, we will meet again.

timeline.summary: Rowan blasts the floor and rises into the air, vowing one day to bring the blessed slumber to all of Eldraine, and escapes.
timeline.quote: A boom louder than the fall of a giant.

timeline.summary: Kellan recognizes Ashiok, says they attacked his home and made Rowan Kenrith turn evil, but Oko tells him to trust him instead.
timeline.quote: They made Rowan Kenrith turn—well, evil!

timeline.summary: Rowan and her brother Will are the only known planeswalkers to share a Spark, so wherever one goes the other must follow.
timeline.quote: the only Planeswalkers known to share a Spark.

timeline.summary: Will and his sister Rowan are the only known planeswalkers to share a Spark; wherever one goes the other must follow.
timeline.quote: the only Planeswalkers known to share a Spark.

relations.note: Brother and sister who share a Spark.
relations.quote: Rowan Kenrith and her brother Will are unique in the Multiverse

pages_say.description: A headstrong young lightning-wielding planeswalker, Will's twin sister, who opens the way to Arcavios and leaps into a student duel.
A blond planeswalker with a sword who studies at Prismari and has Witherbloom friends.
A headstrong lightning-wielding planeswalker, Will's twin, who drifts toward Witherbloom friends and starts siphoning magic from elementals.
A young planeswalker with lightning magic, Will's twin, who fights the Oriq and wants to draw on the Snarl.
Will's twin sister, who draws on the Snarl, burns Extus, collapses from the backlash, and then feeds Will her power.
A friend of Quint he has not seen since the invasion.
A twin and knight-sorceress of Eldraine's royal family who unleashes a devastating lightning bolt and discovers she can no longer planeswalk.
A knight and sorceress of Eldraine's royal family who searches the wilds for a cure for the Wicked Slumber and dreams of her dead parents.
A knight and sorceress who fights through sleeping knights at Castle Ardenvale and is seduced by Eriette's offer to become her heir.
A knight and sorceress who knocks Kellan and Ruby out, fights her brother's army for Eriette, and then blasts the castle and escapes into the sky.
A person Kellan says Ashiok manipulated into turning evil.
A knight-trained planeswalker who uses electrical magic and shares a Spark with her brother Will.
Will's sister, who shares a Spark with him.
